title: Profile registry (core/profiles.yaml): every tool account that feeds this harness

id.description: Readable id used everywhere else, e.g. claude-code-personal.

label.description: Which account, in your words (no e-mail or credentials).

environment.description: Where this account's tool runs: on your computer (local) or in a cloud session (cloud).

previous_ids.description: Ids this profile had before being renamed (references to them are rewritten).

machine.description: For local profiles: which computer (e.g. office, home). Same account on two computers = two profiles.
